stitchPrompt: Create a B2B operator console called “AI Spend Hold Music” for small business owners managing AI subscription and usage costs. Show a compact spend queue, vendor rows, token/seat spike alerts, human-touch risk notes, monthly cap controls, and a savings receipt panel. Design direction: use the operator-dense profile with crisp compact tables, charcoal/navy surfaces, tabular numbers, one sharp action accent, and no decorative hero section.
